aboutText: TCB Tiling & Renovations brings over 20 years of dedicated experience to Taylors Hill and Melbourne's western suburbs. Specialising in bathroom and kitchen renovations, we provide high-quality tiling services that transform spaces. Our local knowledge ensures we meet the unique needs of each project, delivering results that exceed expectations. From initial consultation to final installation, our team handles every aspect with precision and care, making us the trusted choice for homeowners and businesses alike.
servicesText: From bathroom renovations to kitchen tiling, we offer a comprehensive range of services tailored to your needs. Our skilled team handles everything from waterproofing to floor and wall tiling, ensuring a flawless finish every time.
